summary: Held policy changes stay visible for approval, and Reset TAP always responds.

fixes.title: Held changes stay visible under Approvals
fixes.text: After anyone opened Access reviews, Approvals stopped showing held policy changes until a restart. They now stay visible and can be approved.

fixes.title: Reset TAP always answers
fixes.text: Clicking Reset TAP before the list had loaded did nothing. It now finds the admin anyway, or says so if the admin cannot be found.
